PERSONALITY »


Luariia is a tricky, fun seeking, arrogant, all powerful witch. She believes that everyone should have the right to pursue everything they want in life, without having someone to hinder or restrict them. However, she is not naive. She knows that everyone deserves freedom, but only if they are strong enough to take it. She has come to believe in balance, an ideal that is widely shared by many witches. She does not use labels like good and evil. One is meaningless with out the other, and morality is just a state of mind.

She likes to talk things through, rather than resorting to any kind of physical violence. However, she is far from a pacifist; she will not hesitant to kill if negotiations have failed, or she believes they are doomed from the start. Luariia is not what you would call an honorable or straight forward fighter. She will use any and everything as a weapon against her foe. She takes advantage of her own biting wit, mischievous mind, and surroundings to find a way to come out on top, or at least buy time for an escape. She isn't afraid, of anything, not even death, and will most likely only flee a battle, if she thinks it would annoy her opponent.

She enjoys talking with people, and for the most part is polite if not a bit playful in the presences of new company. She never seems to take anything too seriously, and there are very few things that bring her to anger, and even when she is you’d never know it. She holds herself with absolute pose, rarely showing unfavorable emotions. She is attracted to power, both physical and political, and is not shy about showing sexual interest, and she doesn't care whether they be male or female, or even human. However this does not necessarily mean she will act on such desires, unless she feels it would be favorable to her. Or if she's just in the mood.

If a task has no profit, or no fun, then it does not interest her. She only does what suits her needs and can push her own goals forwards. Her only exception to this is when she is asked to help by someone she considers a friend. Such people are very few and far between. A friend is someone you can truly relies on, and believe in. She does not use the word so carelessly. To her a friend his almost like family, in some cases even closer than family. The lucky few that can call her a friend, know that they made a loyal and very powerful ally.

To everyone else however, she is an enigma, wrapped in a mystery, tied with a pretzel, stuffed in a puzzle box wearing crazy pants. She sometimes seems to lie for no reason other than to lie, she makes jokes at inappropriate times, has no regard for authoritative figures, or anyone around her for that matter, unless playing the part of loyal subject can push her own goals forward. She plays pranks on the unsuspecting public, and often time pretends to be someone else, just for kicks. She simply does what suits her at any given time. She is cunning, devious, seductive, and selfish, but she looks after those she see as family with a fierce and merciless determination.


Appearance »


Luariia has very delicate and elegant features. She has silky, raven black hair. It very long but she unusual has it pinned up, or in a ponytail, to show off her long elegant neck. Her eyes are almond shaped, and are a a deep violet in color. When in an excited state the eyes will glow a much brighter shade of Violet. They are like starring into two pools of magically energy. They hold a deep determination, and power in them. She is not heavily muscled, and her body looks more like a princesses rather than a warriors.

Her body is slender yet curvy. Her hair is unbelievable, just devastating long. It is mostly a dark black color, but she has dyed her hair different colors in parts of the 200m tapestry that is her hair, allowing for more creative visuals when she uses her Catwalk stunner, not wanting to limit herself to just the black that is he natural hair color. She has flawless alabaster skin; she looks like a living statue, only her skin is irresistibly soft. she has a heart shaped, and averaged sized ears. She has full lips that always to be pursed as if asking for a kiss.

She has a mole located at bottom of her left cheek close to her lips. From those lips flows angelic voice, perfectly suited for someone with the devil in them. This is all brought together with an adorable button nose. She has an hour glass shape, with a sizable bust(but not over huge, like C-cups tops), and a thin waist that tapers down to a pert rear. Her legs are long, and powerful. That power can be seen in her stride. As every time she step it's like she is on a cat walk. Her stride demands attention, and admiration. It seems like she was made to seduce, men and women alike.

Her outfit is forever changing because she doesn't wear much clothing to begin with. She uses her Catwalk Stunner, to create her clothing of the day. Her casual wear, created by the Catwalk Stunner is a purple shirt draped over a tattered black skirt, that would appear to have been made from animal hide, and under that skirt of a pair of equally tattered black pants. The Left arm was covered all the way up to the shoulder in a sleeve, and on the shoulder there was feather like appendages.
On the same left wrist along with the sleeve was a metal band. She looked like what you would expect a Witch to look like,[Picture].

She will wear a black catsuit that is created from her hair via the Catwalk stunner jutsu, within the Wicked Weaves Techniques. While using this her hairstyle will also vary. While her catsuit and hairstyle will vary, she does have a pair of looks she favors for battle, [Style 1], [Style 2]. She wears what appear to be a pair of glasses, that have the design of butterfly wings close to the lenses. However, they or more than just simple glasses.They are a set of specialized sniper googles that house an assortment of lens.



History »


Luariia was born in Kazi no Kuni, her mother is a powerful ancient Warlock, and her father, a powerful Witch in his own right, and the son of the first and most Powerful Witch, Morgana LeFaye. He had eyes that could see the flow of magic, commonly known as the Sharigan. A trait that was hoped to been passed down to Luariia. Being Born to such parent should have destined her to a life of luxury, being born with a tremendous destiny. However, in this case the opposite was true, she was born cursed, and has experienced nothing but hard ships which the moment of her birth. Her father was killed by powerful Venators, who were in pursuit of her parents and her pregnant mother, Echidna, the Mother of Monsters.

They knew that she would be vulnerable in this stage of her pregnancy, so they attacked. They had hoped to kill her, and the cursed spawn that grew in her belly. They could not allow a one of Echidna's children to be born with the potential to access the Sharigan. However, Luariia's father, managed to hold them off. He killed some and heavily wounded some others, but it came at the cost of his life. His mother Morgana, arrived just in time to watch her son die. She had deduced that the only reason that the Venators were able to locate her son was because Echidna has tipped them off to their location. Most like in an attempt to get her son killed, so that she alone could influence her grand daughter. She would not let Luariia be used by her mother, nor would she leave her unprotected. She gathered the rage, and vengeance of first coven to create a powerful curse and infused it into Luariia. This curse sealed off Luariia's ability to use the Sharigan, this way she hoped that Morgana would just case her out, and she could precede to raise the child the way her son wanted.

After she was born Luariia was instantly given to a band of mercenaries hired by her Mother. She gave her child to mercenaries to help keep her safe from anyone who would came after Luariia to get to Her. She would hide her from the world, and Morgana until Luariia's powers manifested.By the time she was 3 she was already a very mischievous child, always playing pranks on her adopted sister, and walking around wearing her adopted brother's clothes pretending to be him. Her adoptive parents put on the guise of being artist. The mother made one of a kind pottery vases, decorative plates, and sculptures; the father would then paint them. Both claimed to draw on their surroundings for inspiration. This was an easy way to disguise their need for constant travel. Such traveling would normally be dangerous, but they weren't exactly helpless artists. It also helped that Luariia's powers began to manifest earlier than excepted. She performed things that no normal child should be able to, and managed to save the mercenaries more often than not. She learned things extraordinarily fast, she spoke in a language that none of them have ever even heard of. She was an odd, and terrifying child sometimes. Dye got wind of her child's power manifesting, and knew it was time to bring her home.

Dye set up a meeting with the mercenary to discuss their final payment, and to take back her child. Luariia was around 5 years old at the time, and when Dye got a look at her she believed she was the most beautiful child she had ever seen. Dye began to deliver the mercenaries their payment, but the mercenaries, refused. They enjoyed Luariia, but they weren't exactly trying to take her for themselves. They just wanted more money. They were trying to extort the Mother of Monsters, telling her that they never told Luariia who her real parents were, and she would be so cruel too snatch her from the only life she has ever known. It was the easiest job they could imagine, getting paid to guard a being who would more often than not protect them instead. Needless to say, Dye did not appreciate what they were doing.

Later that night Luariia was awakened by the sounds of her adoptive family screaming. Her older brother and sister ran to her and escaped with her out the back. However, they were soon over run by masked bandits, and monsters. One of bandits pried Luariia from her sister’s grip and ran off with them. Luariia struggled to get free, as she heard her brothers and sister calling her name. Soon the screams had stopped. Suddenly, the bandit that was carrying her had an arrow in his head and fell over dead dropping Luariia from his arms.

When Luariia looked up it was the personal guard of Mistress Dye that had dealt to the killing blows to his kidnappers. Luariia hurried over to her, and tried to get her to help his brothers and sister. But Mistress Dye gave her a sad look, “My precious child, I fear they are already dead." Now that she was without a family, Mistress Dye took back her child. Echidna had hoped that the tragic events would have been enough to unlock the girls Sharigan, thanks to Morgana's Curse it did not. She was a bit disappointed, but she took her anyway to see what she would need to do to unleash her power. She spent the next 5 years of her life with Mistress Dye, but it wasn’t the life he had experienced with her adoptive family. Mistress Dye was highly over protective and treated her more like a piece of art rather than her child, or a human being for that matter. She never even took the time to let Luariia know that she was actually Dye's child. Echidna forced her through traumatic event after traumatic event in order to force her Sharigan out of her.

Over the 5 years of staying with Mistress Dye, she had heard things about her, while he explored the grounds. She had heard that she had an obsession for beautiful things, and that she would do just about anything to obtain it. The more she heard about it the more she started to think. Luariia started to wonder if that night when his family supposedly died was less a tragedy, and more of a coordinated event. She honestly didn’t know what was true anymore, but she knew she wasn’t going to be staying with Mistress Dye. Having thoroughly explored the estate over the past 5 years, she escaped rather easily that night. At least that was what she assumed, in reality this was all set up by Dye, she saw that the Sharigan wasn't developing under these circumstances, so she wanted to try different methods.

Luariia spent the next 3 1/2 years looking for any info on her parents, while trying to escape the notice of Mistress Dye and her expansive information network. Time and time again her mother managed to find her, fate it seemed was not on her side. Echidna kept a watchful eye on her, whenever she made a connection a meaningful connect with any person or place, Echidna's forces descended on her destroying everything that she held dear. At first it was a way of trying to force the Sharingan out of her. Echidna gave up on that, seeing Luariia as a failure of a child, and started to do so as punishment for her uselessness, and rebelliousness. Luariia eventually found herself in Konoha, and then decided to become a ninja, for the extra protection, and the safety to grow stronger, without worry. And grow strong she did. On her 17th birthday, she meet her mother, her real mother again. There she learned to true story of her origin,or what she believed to be the true story. As well as who her real parents were. She understood, why her mother did what she did, and even sympathized with her a little bit.

Just when she felt that she could forgive her mother, Echidna cast her from her. Luariia had not yet unlocked the Sharingan and Echidna had deemed that she would never do so, labeling her as a failure. Proving to Luariia that her mother saw not only her, but all the children that she had bore as nothing more than tools to push her own agenda. Echidna, gave her a head start as a final act of motherly love, telling her that she would destroy all excess waste. Luariia continued to gather her power, and even created the first Coven of witches seen in several hundred years, in order to take down her mother and her organization. Even if that meant killing every one of her brother and sisters that the Mother of Monsters had bore.

Not long after that she met and fell in love with Shiki Senri, a young Kyoudo boy, as stubborn and dumb as he was good looking. They were together nearly 3 years before she was asked to marry him to which she gladly accepted. During this this time while a quest in search for more power to defeat her mother, she encountered her Grandmother, Morgana LeFaye. It was here that the old witch empowered the potion that Luariia had stolen from a Time Traveling Demon and gave Luariia the means in which to fully control the immense power that it brought. It was then that she was able to grab hold of her own cursed power, became aware of the Y'la Spirit that stalked her since birth, and the curse that it placed on her Sharingan. With her new power she broke that curse, unleashing her Extraordinary Sharingan, that had be chained for so long. In one encounter, she had become the very thing that Echidna had been trying to create her entire existence. The perfect heir. Now that being had arrive, but it was not coming to serve, by to destroy her and everything she had built.

Type: Main, Protection, Armour
Effect: Identification: Difficult; Hardness: 25; Armour Points/Inch: 30; Armour Class: -5 Beryllium incredibly weighs one-tenth as much as steel, while it possesses a hardness of 25 and 30 Armour Points per inch of thickness.
Special: Incredibly lightweight but also amazingly strong and resistant to heat and corrosion, armor and shields crafted from this metal command a hefty premium on the open market. Beryllium armor confers Fire and Acid resistance 5% per Armour Piece to its wearer and bestows a +1 circumstance bonus to Saves against either energy form.
Special abilities: Fearsome; Movement activation. This item is dark in color, and anyone viewing it sees fleeting, grotesque images on its surface. When the user activates an apparel that has this property, the user creates an aura of Terror in a 6-meter radius around themselves. Every creature in this area briefly perceives a creature from its worst nightmare instead of the user, becoming panicked for 1 round. On a successful Will Save 10 + 2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will, the creature is shaken for 1 round instead. The fearsome property functions 3 times per day. Masking Tendrils of dense black smoke stream from every opening in the equipment, obscuring all detail. Masking Equipment protects the user and their gear from Divination Jutsus, Rituals, and Items as if the user was constantly under the effect of non-detection. Dread The wearer of this armour is shrouded in a dreadful aura of fear. Creatures in a 10-meter radius with fewer Class Points than the wearer must succeed on a Will Save 10 +2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will or be affected as though by a Fear Jutsu. A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by the same wearer's aura for 24 hours. Frightful Presence: The wearer becomes unsettling to their foes, gaining the frightful Presence ability. The wearer can activate this ability as part of an offensive action, such as a charge or attack. Opponents within 10 meters of the wearer must make a Will save or become shaken for 3d6 rounds. If the wearer has at least 4 more Class Points than the opponent, that opponent becomes frightened instead. Foes with more Class Points are immune to this effect. Terrifying Gaze: Viewing the wearer's face inspires terror. Creatures within 10 meters that meet the wearer's gaze must succeed at a Will Save or suffer the effects of a Fear Jutsu. These are mind-affecting fear effects. The wearer can suppress and reactivate these abilities as Free Movements. Menacing; When the user activates menacing armour (Weaving movement), the user becomes frightening. Any one creature (user's choice) within 10 meters with fewer Class Points than the user must have a successful Will Save (10 + 2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will) or be panicked for 5 rounds. A creature that succeeds on a Save is shaken for 1 round instead, and is immune to further uses of this property from the same suit of Armour for 24 hours. The Menacing property functions 3 times per day. Mask of Fear +25 Enchantment Bonus to Intimidate. +5 to Saves when performing Fear Jutsus. The wearer gains Frightful Presence (10 + 2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will), which lasts for 2d6 rounds and activates whenever the wearer makes a threatening movement, and has a range of 10 meters. Those who fail the save will become shaken. This effect does not affect Dragons, nor Creatures of Animal Intelligence and lower. Elemental Immunity; Power 1/day, non-movement. The wearer becomes immune to one of the following energy types chosen at the seal's construction: Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire, and Sonic. Lasts 5 rounds. Enlivening When activated, the wearer of this object gains 2 Temporary Armour Points per Class Point they possess. The wearer can activate this property once per day as a Non-Movement and the Temporary Armour Points last for 3 minutes.
Drawback: ---

Crystal IceRank: S
Type: Secondary, 50 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
Effect: A harnessed Gem that dramatically decreases the temperature, freezing water, and many other things in a large area for a period of 12 hours.
Special: ---
Drawback: ---
Description: Crystal Ice is harnessed from a diamond with a deep blue color and is the size of a human thumbnail. The natural alchemical properties of the diamond can be harnessed by a skilled Alchemist crafting the diamond into the shape of a one-inch square cube. Once crafted, crystal ice allows the bearer to dramatically lower the temperature in an area extending out in a 100-meter radius from the gem once per day. Once activated, the temperature within the area of effect gradually lowers to well below freezing (-150° F) over a period of 3 rounds. This dramatic drop in temperature lasts for 12 hours. The extreme temperature conditions created by crystal ice cause unprotected characters to suffer 6 Armour Points of damage for each minute of exposure. Any existing weather conditions that were in place when the gem is activated are stacked on top of the extreme cold created by the gem. For example, rain becomes freezing rain or snow; fog becomes freezing fog, etc. If crystal ice is placed in water and activated, the water will become frozen out to the area of effect of the gem. If placed in a large enough body of water (large lake, ocean) the gem will create a hemisphere of ice to a depth of 100 meters and a diameter of 200 meters. Crystal ice that is activated in the presence of a water elemental that is unable to flee before the full effects take place, will become frozen into a solid block of ice. The elemental is unharmed by this transformation and returns to its normal state once the duration of the activation expires. The gem may trap aquatic animals if activated in water. These animals become frozen within the ice created and are unharmed by the process, returning to normal once the duration of the activation expires. Crystal ice has no effect on creatures (other than elementals) with the water sub-type. Fire-based creatures suffer 12 Armour Points of damage for each minute of exposure to the gems effects.
Limit: These types of items may be bought inside any Alchemy Shop. With a 10% chance of finding.
Cost: 60,000 Ryo Each.
Gems of Energy (Fire Moderate)Rank: S
Type: Secondary, 50 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
Effect: A harnessed Gem giving resistance towards energy attacks.
Special: ---
Drawback: ---
Description: Jewelers have long prized topaz for its wide array of colors. A shaman first learned of the natural Alchemical properties that can be harnessed from the topaz gem. This knowledge was passed only among other shamans for many generations but, like all things, the secret of the natural Alchemical properties was soon learned by other Alchemists. Today, Gems of Energy can be found across the globe. To harness the Alchemy from the topaz, a gem of the correct color must be carved into the correct shape. Depending on the beginning value of the topaz, the gem of energy will provide slight, moderate, or greater protection from one of the five different energy sources; Fire, Electricity, Cold, Acid, or Sonic (whether from a natural or Chakra source). The list below details the colors of the topaz, their carved shape, value, and what protection they provide. The gems grant energy resistance to the bearer so that each time the creature takes damage from the appropriate source, that damage is then reduced by the appropriate amount.

Red - Fire - Flame Carving - Moderate 20

The protective power from gems of energy does not stack, so wearing multiple gems of one color does not increase the amount of damage that is reduced. The gems do stack with other sources of energy resistance, including Jutsus like resist energy or other Chakra or non- Chakra items. In these cases the Protection Jutsu absorbs damage first until its power has been exhausted. Different types of gems of energy can be worn to provide protection from multiple energy sources.
Limit: These types of items may be bought inside any Alchemy Shop. With a 10% chance of finding for Slight. With a 5% chance of finding for Moderate. With a 1% chance of finding for Greater.
Cost: Moderate - 100,000 Ryo Each.

Troll Stone x2Rank: S
Type: Secondary, 15 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
Effect: A harnessed Gem that gives the holder the ability to heal damage while turning all damage against them into nonlethal damage.
Special: ---
Drawback: ---
Description: The Troll Stone is a highly prized item. First harnessed by Hanna Whynn, a master healer of Sound, the Goddess of Healing, the troll stone has since become a staple in many adventurers’ kits. A Troll Stone is harnessed from a large crystal of citrine when the gem is carved into a rough image of a troll. To benefit from the gems' alchemical properties, the Troll Stone must be held in the hand. When held, all damage dealt to the bearer is considered to be nonlethal damage. In addition, the bearer heals nonlethal damage at the rate of Minor Wounds per round. Fire and acid attacks deal normal damage to the bearer while holding the Troll Stone (any resistances, Chakra or otherwise, the bearer may possess against these attack forms still apply). The bearer can also reattach severed limbs while holding the Troll Stone. To reattach a body part, the severed part must touch the body while the person has the Troll Stone. (Putting the troll stone in a severed hand has no effect.) If the bearer of the Troll Stone stops touching it, any nonlethal damage that was previously dealt and not yet healed immediately converts to lethal damage.
Limit: These types of items may be bought inside any Alchemy Shop. With a 5% chance of finding.
Cost: 184,000 Ryo Each.
Tear of Raijin x2Rank: S
Type: Secondary, 50 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
Effect: A more powerful Version of the Lightning Gem. Allowing the possessor to rain down bolts of powerful lightning against their opponents.
Special: ---
Drawback: ---
Description: The emerald has long been prized as a gemstone, valued for its deep green color. The druids have a long and rich Alchemical history and they were the first to discover the alchemical potential locked away within the emerald. Since its discovery, the lightning gem has become a powerful weapon. When an emerald is cut into the shape of a six-pointed star the gems Alchemy is harnessed. Through the used a ancient magic the power of the gem has been greatly increases. From that point on, a person can use the lightning gem 3 times per day to call forth bolts of lightning from the sky. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a vertical stroke at whatever target point the user chooses within 240 meters of the user's position. A maximum of 15 bolts can be called down over a 1-minute period, one bolt called per round. Each bolt is 2 meters wide and 10 meters long and deals 75 Armour Points of damage. If the lightning gem is used outside in stormy weather (a rain shower, clouds and wind, hot and cloudy conditions, or even a tornado) each bolt deals 125 Armour Points of damage instead. Dokkalfar Grand Witch - Dokkalfar
This Augmentation Template can be added to any humanoid, of Dokkalfar Ancestry. It uses all of the user's existing statistics and abilities, and simply layers on a package of related Augmentations. The Grand Witch Template ties one closer to nature than most other beings on the the planet. Giving them, access to abilities that grant to defenses against the elements, being in tuned with and drawing on nature to sustain themselves. This templates more room to breath than most others, as nature draws out the innate potential and appeal within the subject. this Springs forth more diverse abilities depending on the subject. It also come with draw backs, as the Mother Goddess takes away as much as she gives.
Drawbacks: Achilles Heel, Achilles Heel, Achilles Heel, Achilles Heel, Achilles Heel, Achilles Heel, Nightmares, Uncontrollable Rage, Material Allergy, Thin Skin
Augmentations: Expanded Lungs, Shock Absorber, Adrenaline Jolt, Energy Diffusion(Sound and Acid), Enhanced Metabolism, Filtered Lungs, Hypersensitivity, Pheromone, Soothing, Piercing Howl, Dual Brains, Energy Absorption(Sound and Acid), Photosynthetic, Density Manipulation.

As the user does so they create a somewhat "vacuum" like effect within their own chakra along the palm of their hands. What this occurs is when the user grows close to the opponent and does a punching like motion the opponent will feel a small amount of chakra escape from their very own body and be used towards the user's own special like force. This damage does not apply to creatures like clones or summon creatures. With the right release the user may imbue the weapon with that release.
    • Crushing (Earth affinity, Earth descriptor): The crushing weapon has hardness 20, bypasses cold iron damage reduction and ignores hardness from objects with 8 hardness or below. Objects enhanced with this effect retain normal hardness. The weapon gains a +2 enchantment bonus to attack damage.
    • Vibrating (Lightning affinity, Electricity descriptor): The vibrating weapon ignores all hardness from objects and up to 5 points of damage reduction. Objects enhanced with this effect retain normal hardness. The weapon gains a +2 enchantment bonus to attack damage.
    • Searing (Fire affinity, Fire descriptor): The searing weapon reduces the hardness and damage reduction of objects or creatures it strikes by 2 for 3 rounds. Each hit reduces hardness and damage reduction further by 2, up to a maximum of 10, but does not refresh the duration. This effect ends after the weapon successfully hits 5 times. The weapon gains a +2 enchantment bonus to attack damage.
    • Slicing (Wind affinity, Wind descriptor): The slicing weapon ignores up to 15 points of hardness or damage reduction. The effect ends after the weapon successfully hits 4 times. The weapon gains a +2 enchantment bonus to attack damage.
    • Slowing (Water affinity, Water descriptor): The slowing weapon reduces the Defense of the creature it hits by 1 for 2 rounds. Each hit further reduces the target's Defense by 1, maximum -5. The effect ends after the weapon successfully hits 5 times. The weapon gains a +2 enchantment bonus to attack damage.

    Transformation Tree »


    TransformationRank: D
    Skill: NinJutsu
    Effect: Using this technique, the user assumes the form of a creature of same size category as he is or smaller.
    Special: Handseals
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Range of this technique is personal. Duration of this technique is 50 minutes per Class Level. User may freely designate the specifics of his new form (such as height, weight, hair texture and color, skin tone, etc.). In this new form, the user keeps their armour points, saves, allegiance and special abilities, but they are adjusted accordingly as per the new Size category (if any change occured), and does not gain any of their new form's abilities other than its natural weapons and cannot change their voice. In this new form, the user can use all their abilities unless they use a limb or body part that they previously did not have in their original form. The user can create equipment, natural weapons or simply make it so that their new form carries the same equipment as they do, but cannot create something overly complicated or that uses Chakra (no mastercrafted objects, no advanced weaponry, exploding tags, summoning scrolls, etc); any part of the body or piece of equipment that is separated from the whole reverts to its true form. The user cannot use any technique of any type unless their form allows them to, but is still capable of speech even if their new form would not usually be. Even in their new form, the user retains their own creature type and does not gain any immunities they would with another. The new form cannot be smaller than Tiny and the user gains a +25 bonus to Disguise checks per Class Level (maximum +75) if the user uses the technique to disguise into another creature. The new form will not provide warmth if they are not clothed. The user can also use Transformation to transform into an object of their size category or smaller, but that is no smaller than Tiny. The user cannot transform into advanced weaponry or mastercrafted weapons, nor can they replicate the effects of an object crafted. The user may use Transformation to transform their clones. The range of the technique in this case is 7 meters + 6 meters per Class Level and affects any clones at the user's discretion within that range. When the a transformed creature is hit while maintaining a transformation, it must succeed a Will Save check (10 + 1/2 Damage dealt) or see the technique abruptly end. A creature that interacts with or intently observes the transformed creature may make an Observation check to recognize it as transformed, but will not be able to determine what the true form of the creature or the user is. Creatures that can See Chakra or See Through Chakra can make an Observation check to notice chakra moving in an odd pattern around the user, which will in turn allow the creature to make a Chakra Lore check (Difficult Difficulty) to identify the pattern as a result of Transformation.
    Limit: Must learn from Universal NinJutsu.

This unique ability manifests in a clan member's eyes, and while some might call it a genetic aberration of deformity, the Uchiha have used this gift to devastating effect. In some members this ability will only let them anticipate or predict the path of an attack. The user activates this ability as a "C" Rank weaving movement that does not provoke an opportunity of attack. Each Rank learned the user gains a Tomoe (maximum 3). User gains a +10 insight bonus to Investigate, Observation, Reading Lips, and Forgery (to copy writers) checks per Tomoe. User gains a +10 insight bonus to Sense Motive against Feints per Tomoe. User gains a +2 insight bonus to Intimidate per Tomoe. User gains a +2 insight bonus to Will Saves against GenJutsu and Mind-Affecting Jutsus per Tomoe. User gains a +2 insight bonus to Attack Damage per Tomoe. User gains a +2 insight bonus to Dodge per Tomoe. The user can concentrate for a move-movement to gain the ability to "See Chakra" for as long as the user concentrates, plus 5 rounds. The Sharingan eye costs chakra per round to maintain. If the user is blinded, user gains none of the benefits of the Sharingan. Unless caught flat-footed, immobilized, or feinted against, the character cannot lose Minor Defenses while the Sharingan is Active. Deactivating this is a free movement. When the user unlocks the 3rd Tomoe they gain the ability Glare. User gains a +20 bonus to Observation to detect GenJutsu techniques or see Chakra Activity (see See Chakra). The Difficulty Saves of a character's Eye Techniques increases by +1 no named bonus while their Sharingan is active.

    Hypnotic StareRank: B
    Skill: NinJutsu
    Effect: A stare that reduces the target's Will while making the target forget the user being affected.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: A Sharingan based technique. A user can focus their stare on 1 creature within 7 meters + 6 meters per Class Level as a weaving movement. That creature takes a -2 penalty on Will Saves. This penalty changes to -3 at "C" Class. A user can maintain their stare against only 1 opponent at a time; it remains in effect until the user stares at a new target, the opponent dies, the opponent moves farther than the range, or the user falls unconscious or dies. The user can remove the memory of their stare from the target's mind; the creature does not remember that it was affected (nor does it realize that it is currently being affected) unless the user allows it. The hypnotic stare is a psychic effect, and relies more on the Uchiha's focus than the target's Observation of their stare. It cannot be avoided in the same ways a gaze attack can. The Uchiha can use this ability even while blinded, but must succeed at a Verify Difficult Observation check to do so. Staring at a creature requires the Uchiha's focus, so if they use their gaze attack or similar ability, user must target the subject of their hypnotic stare or voluntarily end the stare. The penalties from multiple Uchihas' stares do not stack. This is a mind-affecting effect.
    Limit: Must be an Uchiha. Must know Sharingan.

    • Allure: Hypnotic Stare penalty applies to Initiative and Observation.
    • Disquiet: Target is shaken while in areas of total darkness.
    • Lethality: Hypnotic Stare penalty applies to Fortitude saves versus poison and disease.
    • Nightblindness: The darkvision range of the Hypnotic Stare's target decreases by 6 meters.
    • Oscillation: Hypnotic Stare treats all enemies beyond 10 meters (except user) as having concealment.
    • Psychic Inception: Hypnotic Stare affects creatures that are Mindless or Immune to Mind-affecting effects.
    • Restriction: Hypnotic Stare treats all areas of dim light or darker as difficult terrain.

    • Susceptibility: Hypnotic Stare penalty applies to target's Sense Motive checks.
    • Timidity: Hypnotic Stare penalty applies to Attack Damage.

The user can choose to Copy, Memorize, or Nullify.
    • Copy: The character performs the technique as it was performed by the opponent the user copied from, and it has the same effects. The user gains a +1 Enchantment Bonus to Training Points per Post made to develop the technique for 2 weeks. If unused, the bonus fades.
    • Memorize: The character gains a +2 Enchantment Bonus to Training Points per Post made to develop the technique for 1 month. If unused, the bonus fades. User regains 1/2 the Chakra cost they used to initiate this maneuver.
    • Nullify (GenJutsu or NinJutsu only): The character counters the creature performing the technique, and the technique has no effect. The character gains a +1 Enchantment Bonus to Training Points per post made to develop the technique for 2 weeks. If unused, the bonus fades. A technique with a Personal range cannot be nullified.

"B" Class 10 Armour Points against said Defenses and a natural Damage Reduction 5/Evil. "A" Class 15 Armour Points against said Defenses and a natural Damage Reduction 10/Evil.

    • Fiendish Creature Defenses: Fiendish Gains Defenses to Resist against Cold, and Fire. "C" Class user gains 5 Armour Points against said defenses. "B" Class 10 Armour Points against said Defenses and a natural Damage Reduction 5/Good. "A" Class 15 Armour Points against said Defenses and a natural Damage Reduction 10/Good.

Force Hammer has no effect on non-living creatures or objects. Creatures that are Immune to non-lethal damage cannot be dazed by the Jutsu.

Undead creatures take an additional +2 Armour Points of damage per Class Level. A creature struck by the mace becomes paralyzed for 1 round. The wall cannot move, it is immune to damage of all kinds, and it is unaffected by most Jutsus, including Dispel Chakra. Breath weapons and Jutsus cannot pass through the wall in either direction, although Teleporting, and similar effects can bypass the barrier. It blocks ethereal creatures as well as material ones (though ethereal creatures can usually get around the wall by floating under or over it through material floors and ceilings). Gaze attacks can operate through a Wall of Force. The user can form the wall into a flat, vertical plane whose area is up to one 15 meter squared area per Class Level. The barrier must be formed so that its flat surface faces the user. An instant barrier is destroyed by any Jutsu or effect that destroys a Wall of Force. Breath weapons and Jutsus cannot pass through an instant barrier, though a spread effect can reach those behind it if a clear path is available. The Jutsu otherwise functions as a Wall of Force. Because of its name Instant Barrier can be evoked without sacrificing a movement, it can be used to cause a fireball to detonate early or to stop a charging creature in their tracks.

Hide in plain sight takes up the amount of Handseals equal to a "C" Rank technique without performing the Handseals.

    WraithformRank: DCBA "S"

    Drawback: ---

The duration of this technique lasts for 5 minutes per Class Level. While in Wraithform creatures that interact with the subject feels they are attacking normally, however they are actually hitting much less than normal when it comes to TaiJutsu attacks. Being Wraithformed has several effects:
    Depending on the Rank the user knows (and the rank they perform) depends on the Reduction in TaiJutsu Damage.
    • "D" Rank reduces Attack damage by 10 Armour Points.
    • "C" Rank reduces Attack damage by 20 Armour Points.
    • "B" Rank reduces Attack damage by 30 Armour Points.
    • "A" Rank reduces Attack damage by 40 Armour Points.
    • "S" Rank reduces Attack damage by 50 Armour Points.

    Non-Chakra attacks suffer percentile chance of missing versus the Wraithformed creature depending on the user's knowledge of this technique.
    • "D" Rank gives a 10% chance of miss.
    • "C" Rank gives a 20% chance of miss.
    • "B" Rank gives a 30% chance of miss.
    • "A" Rank gives a 40% chance of miss.
    • "S" Rank gives a 50% chance of miss.

    Takes a certain amount of damage on Chakra Techniques depending on the user's knowledge of this technique. Only Pure Chakra techniques affect normally.
    • "D" Rank reduces Chakra damage by 10 Armour Points.
    • "C" Rank reduces Chakra damage by 20 Armour Points.
    • "B" Rank reduces Chakra damage by 30 Armour Points.
    • "A" Rank reduces Chakra damage by 40 Armour Points.
    • "S" Rank reduces Chakra damage by 50 Armour Points.

    There is only 20% chance that Wraithformed creatures leave behind footprints, their scent, or make a sound while moving no matter the rank the user knows.

    The creature seems to be floating however they are not. If the creature has the natural ability to fly then the Wraithformed creature is able to fly.

    Mastery Tech »


    Glamour PerceptionRank: D
    Skill: GenJutsu
    Effect: Jutsu allows the user to perform Glamour Perceptions.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Glamours cannot produce real effects, but they can change things that already exist. That's the chief difference between a Figment and a Glamour. If you want solid wood to feel rotten, birdcalls to sound like the shrieks of the damned, an otyugh to smell like perfume, or a disguise yourself, you probably want a glamour. As with Figments, everyone within range perceives the same thing and reacts appropriately.
    Limit: ---
    Glamourer: A Thousand VisagesRank: A
    Skill: GenJutsu
    Effect: A Glamourer gains the ability to change their appearance at will.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: The user's appearance changes, including clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment. The user can seem 1 size category smaller shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in-between. The user cannot change its body type. For example, a human user could look human, humanoid, or like any other generally human-shaped bipedal creature. Otherwise, the extent of the apparent change is up to the user. A minor feature could be added or obscured, such as a mole or a beard, or the user could look like an entirely different person. The Jutsu does not provide the abilities or mannerisms of the chosen form. It does not alter the perceived tactile (touch) or audible (sound) properties of the user or its equipment. A battleaxe made to look like a dagger still functions as a battleaxe. The user does not have to perform Handseals when using Glamourer: A Thousand Visages, however it does take the amount of time equal to "C" Rank worth of Handseals.
    Limit: Must know the Glamour Perception. Automatically gained once Mastered Glamour Perception.

This burst takes the form of an offensive bolt or burst, similar to that of a Lightning Jutsu or a Fire Jutsu, even though the burst causes no actual damage. However, the burst can be detected at great range as a powerful Jutsu by other chakra sensing Jutsu. The burst itself appears as a faint bluish light, just visible to all creatures within 15 meters of the Jutsu. In addition to this, all creatures with Chakra Sensing Jutsus within 300 meters of the burst automatically become aware that some form of Chakra has just been released, although neither the nature nor the actual purpose of that Chakra will be known. Sensing the technique feels like an "S" Rank technique was released.

This technique may be disbelieved once interacted with. An object appears to be destroyed at the user's touch. User must succeed on a touch attack to affect an object wielded by another creature. A creature that interacts with the object receives a Save to recognize its destruction as illusory.

If the Jutsu is performed on a small objects that is then placed inside or under a light-proof covering, the Jutsu’s effects are blocked until the covering is removed. Deep shadows is countered by any light Jutsu of equal or greater rank.

For purposes of this Jutsu, an attack includes any Jutsu targeting a foe or whose area or effect includes a foe. Actions directed at unattended objects do not break the Jutsu. Causing harm indirectly is not an attack. Thus, an invisible being can open doors, talk, eat, climb stairs, summon and have them attack. Patterns contain an additional, mind-affecting element, and they can cause real, physiological effects. All patterns are Mind-Affecting Jutsus. While everyone sees a color spray, only some of those within the cone actually deal with its effects. Note: that a particular sense is required for patterns to have an effect. Sightless creatures ignore Color Spray, for instance. If you want multiple subjects to be affected by what they see, and you do not care if everyone perceives it happening, pattern might be a good choice.

The victim is visited by the user throughout the vision, and offered escape and healing if they will but take their hand and promise loyalty. The victim faces a choice. If they resist the vision continues. The Jutsu is so horrible there is a cumulative 5% chance per hour that he will go permanently mad (feebleminded). The victim is aware of this. An illusion of the user always visits before a save is rolled to resist being feebleminded and to end the Jutsu. If the victim takes the user's hand and promises loyalty, they wake up. The victims is well, unharmed, and behaves normally – except that they are absolutely convinced that serving the user is the right thing to do, and does so loyally and without question. If the victim attempts to lie, the vision becomes worse (limbs being slowly sawed off, body engulfed in flames and continues to burn for hours, etc.) while the chance to become feebleminded rises to 10% per hour (cumulative). Note that shaking, water, etc. does not awaken the victim; that requires a successful Dispel GenJutsu. If the victim is feebleminded, they can be restored with a heal Jutsus. If she gave into the Jutsu, Dispel GenJutsu can restore her (note that the victim will usually fight to prevent this, as they now feel that serving their new master is the right thing to do).
    Limit: Must know the Phantasm Perception.

    Water Release


    Water is the source of life. Of course I control it.


    Mastery Techniques »


    Water Release SkillRank: D
    Skill: NinJutsu
    Effect: A prerequisite technique that allows the user to perform Water Release techniques.
    Special: Handseals
    Drawback: ---
    Description: This technique does not count against the user's Release Training Points. Water is one of the basic elemental nature transformation techniques allowing the user to manipulate pre-existing water by turning their Chakra into Water. It takes much more ability to create the water outside the body than to manipulate what is already available or expel it from their mouths (Need Water Creation Technique from Jutsu Enhancement Techniques). Water Release techniques can not only change shape but state as well. Moreover, the water becomes more solid in the process as well, and certain techniques can even allow the user to increase the water's density or viscosity, making it a suitable element to capture the targets. Offensive water techniques seem to inflict harm from the sudden force that they exert, which would cause massive internal damage to a human. Any Save Difficulty mentioned in a technique, whether Fortitude or Will is based off of 10 + 2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will. Some Ice Release techniques need pre-existing ice, snow, or water nearby in order to be used. Techniques that require a small source of water nearby is measured between 1.5 to 6 cubic meters. Medium is measured between 6 to 30 cubic meters. Large is measured between 30 cubic meters to 350 cubic meters. Huge is measured between 350 cubic meters to 1,500 cubic meters. Colossal is measured by anything more than 1,500 cubic meters.
    Limit: Must learn for Water Release NinJutsu.
    Temperature ManipulationRank: A
    Skill: Supplementary
    Effect: When the user performs a Water Release technique they may alter the temperature for that technique to deal either Fire Damage, or Cold Damage.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Automatically learned when user Masters Water Release (Has 500 Training Points). User may alter the temperature of the technique when performing. User can increase the heat of water to boiling point levels allowing the Water to deal Fire Damage. On the other hand the user may increase the coldness of water to near freezing temperatures allowing the Water to deal Cold Damage. User may only apply this technique at time of performing and may not alter the temperature of the technique unless they have a separate technique that does so. Water Release technique converts 1 Armour Point per 6 Armour Points of damage into Fire Damage if the user increases the temperature. Water Release technique converts 1 Armour Point per 6 Armour Points of damage into Cold Damage if the user decreases the temperature.
    Limit: Must know Water Release. Must have mastered Water Release.

    • Lower Water: This causes water or similar liquid to reduce its depth by as much as 3 meters per Class Level evel (to a minimum depth of 1 inch). The water is lowered within a squarish depression whose sides are up to user's Class Level x 15 meters long. In extremely large and deep bodies of water, such as a deep ocean, the Jutsu creates a whirlpool that sweeps ships and similar craft downward, putting them at risk and rendering them unable to leave by normal movement for the duration of the Jutsu. When performed on water elementals and other water-based creatures, this Jutsu acts as a slow Jutsu (Will negates) reducing their movements by 1/2. The Jutsu has no effect on other creatures.
    • Raise Water: This causes water or similar liquid to rise in height, just as the lower water version causes it to lower. Boats raised in this way slide down the sides of the hump that the Jutsu creates. If the area affected by the Jutsu includes riverbanks, a beach, or other land nearby, the water can spill over onto dry land. With either version, the user may reduce one horizontal dimension by half and double the other horizontal dimension.

Duration of this technique is 5 rounds per Class Level. This technique requires a colossal source of water nearby. User's Chakra of pure elemental power gather together a wall of water that moves inexorably in the direction of the user's choice, crushing all that it encounters. This Jutsu creates a towering tsunami and sends it forth in a powerful wave to smash all in its path. The tsunami starts at any point the user selects within range of the Jutsu and then moves at a speed of 40 meters in any direction chosen by the user. Once the direction is set, the tsunami cannot change course. The tsunami deals 24 Armour Points of bludgeoning damage per Class Level to all in its path. Gargantuan or larger creatures that fail a Fortitude save are knocked prone. Huge or smaller creatures that fail a Fortitude save are picked up and carried with the wave. Each round a victim is carried by the tsunami, it takes the bludgeoning damage again and can make an additional Fortitude save to stop being carried. Creatures being carried by a tsunami cannot move in any other way. They can otherwise act normally, but must use +2 Handseals/Chakra to perform a Jutsu. Creatures caught in a tsunami take a -4 penalty to Agility. They can escape the wave by making successful Extremely Difficult Difficulty Escape Artist checks, as long as they end their movement outside the effect of the tsunami. Any creature that comes in contact with a tsunami as a result of movement during its turn is considered to have been struck by the tsunami's movement. A creature can attempt to extract another creature caught by a tsunami, providing the rescuer resists being swept up or knocked down by the tsunami and can reach the victim. A tsunami's progress can be halted by anything that would normally block line of effect along its path, assuming the tsunami does not destroy the intervening object or creature. If only a portion of the tsunami is blocked, the rest of it continues on.
    Limit: Must know Water Release. Must know Tidal Wave.

Wind-based techniques are mainly short to mid-ranged offensive techniques that combine brute force and keen precision to deal slashing damage. Wind Release also specifies in deflecting and even reflecting attacks. Wind Techniques come in 7 Wind Effects, which interfere with ranged attacks, or impose penalties on some skill checks. Wind Effects are described in the Combat section of the Player's Handbook under Weather in the Movement and Position section. Any Save Difficulty mentioned in a technique, whether Fortitude or Will is based off of 10 + 2 per Class Level + Impeccable Will.

The chakra causes the whip's cord to wrap around the opponent's weapon, normally around the hilt but can be other places as well. Then, with a sharp tug, the user can attempt to disarm the opponent. If the user does not wish to do this, or is unable to do this, then the whip will remain wrapped around the weapon, inhibiting the weapon's movement until the weapon is free'd from the whip's grasp.

The movement of the wrist causes the whip's cord to move about, changing the location as to where the whip will actually land. With proper training, the shinobi can come to understand that exact way the whip will respond to the movement of the wrist and as such can surprise the enemy by hitting them where they thought they would block or dodge.

Can only be held three turns at the first time this technique is learned. Once stopped, the attack cannot be re-performed for three turns.
    Description: The shinobi stands in place, and then using trained, calculated speeds, the shinobi brings the whip around their body in very fast wrist and arm flicks that cause the whip to move about them. This attack can be used to attack multiple enemies who get too close at once or to deflect incoming projectiles. However, do to the required speeds to make this attack effective, the users arm can tire very quickly, allowing it to only last for up to three turns.     Seigan no Kamae and Chudan no KamaeRank: E
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: Two basic stances used in the art of swordsmanship.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Seigan no Kamae, Chudan no Kamae The Seigan and Chudan no Kamae are similar in every aspect when it comes to looking at the opponent, having their feet placed down upon the floor, as well as the amount of pressure they have between both of their legs. The user keeps their right or left foot forward having their toes pointing forwards. Their opposite foot is shaped in an "L" shaped keeping their legs in equal motion. Their feet are perpendicular from one another as face forward their feet and legs are in shoulder width apart. This is used as a basic formation to where the user can move from either defensive, or defensive movements. For the Seigan no Kamae stance has their hands relaxed, grasped against the handle of the blade in question. The sword is pointing in a forty five degree angle as their arms are relaxed, hands close towards his hips as one would wait and relax. For the Chudan no Kamae the user keeps the same foot work as that of Seigan but their hands is brought up towards chest level as the sword that they hold is slightly more gripped proof. The sword is pointed forward as the blade is pointed down towards the ground. These stances are mostly known for parrying and blocking, as well as making quick attacks upon the opponent.
    Limit: Must Learn from a Master of Burēdono Kenseijin - ブレードの剣聖人 - Blade of the Sword Saint

Their feet are perpendicular from one another as face forward their feet and legs are in shoulder width apart. For each class level the user is higher than "D" Class the distance increases 5 meters in diameter however the amount of rounds of displacement does not increase.

    Gosei Ryuu: Battōjutsu Ōgi - Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki (天翔龍閃, Ōgi - Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki)x3Rank: S
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: The Amakakeru Ryū No Hirameki must be faster than a regular battōjutsu in order to hit the opponent.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: User could cut off their own leg since they are stepping with their off foot.
    Description: The secret behind the technique lays in an additional step with the left (off) foot. This single step alone adds instantaneous acceleration and weight to the sword changing the god-like speed of Burēdono Kenseijin - Blade of the Sword Saint to "Beyond god-like speed". However, this extra step is difficult to take as one of the fundamental teaching of battōjutsu states that one should step forward with the right foot as to avoid cutting their own foot with the attack. As such, the additional step forward with the left foot can spell certain death for the swordsman, as it takes precise timing to coordinate, as to not lose any momentum while drawing; it requires the utmost concentration that can only be obtained by one's desire to live. There is another secret to this technique. If the initial strike is avoided or blocked, the force of the unusually fast slashing motion displaces the air around it, generating a vacuum in its wake and sucking the opponent in. As this happens, the body is spun around for a second strike, the previous action adding force and momentum to the swing, making the subsequent strike far stronger. This is the true power of the Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki. This technique is so fast that its implementation can be successful even when the enemy's strike has actually reached the user's body. This technique may be learned multiple times. Each time learned it increases in power adding an extra "S" Rank of power.
    Limit: Must Learn from a Master of Burēdono Kenseijin, Must know Gosei Ryuu: Battōjutsu (Art of Drawing the Blade), Must have mastered Burēdono Kenseijin - Blade of the Sword Saint

    Description: Before an opponent may draw their blade from the side the user rushes forward and slams their sword back into the sheathe while they move forward along the side of the sword taking hold of the back hand and the sheath of the sword raising both up high while twisting the hand into a hold. This disables the opponent from unsheathing the sword and the user flips the opponent over and performs a more powerful attack as the opponent lies on the floor while the user still has hold of the hand and sheath.

    Tsuyosa Ryuu: Futae no Kiwami (Mastery of Two Layers) x7Rank: B
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: A dual strike technique that allows the user to bypass hardness while delivering a powerful strike. (Ignore 16 hardness|200ap)
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Mastery of Two Layers is a technique that focuses on allowing the full use of one's strength and power to be fully utilized at its maximum output. The Futae no Kiwami's principle aspects come from understanding that all matter bears a level of resistance, and that a single blow's impact is wasted upon meeting this resistance. From this, two blows are to be acted to fully transfer this impact. With the fist, the first blow, using the proximal interphalangeal joints of the hand, meets to absorb the object's initial resistance. The first hit allows the user to bypass +2 Hardness per Class Level. Then, with folding the hand immediately to switch over to the proximal phalanx knuckles, delivers the final strike to the weakened object; in addition, the two hits are to be delivered at nearly the same time, with a few milliseconds interval. The 2nd strike deals 16 Armour Points of Damage per Class Level. The result is the complete destruction of the object (Can destroy overview Objects if it bypasses the Hardness), which has no more resistance to sustain itself and collapses into dust. Technique does double damage against inanimate objects while creating a crater 1/2 a meter per 16 Armour Points of Damage. User may relearn this technique multiple times. Each time learned allows the user to bypass an additional +1 Hardness while dealing +4 Armour Points of Damage per Class Level. May be performed once per movement.
    Limit: Must Learn from a Master of Burēdono Kenseijin
    • Tsuyosa Ryuu: Tou-ate (Distant Hit)
    Rank: B
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: User propels a shockwave of the Tsuyosa Ryuu: Futae no Kiwami (Mastery of Two Layers) through the ground.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: An advanced measure of Futae no Kiwami, the user is able to deliver a shockwave of similar impact upon using the Futae no Kiwami onto a surface. Depending on the execution, the attack can manifest as a grounded radial impact or a surge of force towards the opponent. To determine distance, use Damage output from Futae no Kiwami as if striking a living target. Other Damage output is not applied. Technique may travel in a cone-shape emanation. Distance traveled is 1 meter per 16 Armour Points of Damage, however the damage is reduced by 8 Armour Points of Damage per 1 meter traveled. Technique may travel in a sphere-shaped emanation centered on the user. Distance traveled is 1 meter per 32 Armour Points of Damage, however the damage is reduced by 16 Armour Points per 1 meter traveled.
    Limit: Must Learn from a Master of Burēdono Kenseijin. Must know Tsuyosa Ryuu: Futae no Kiwami (Mastery of Two Layers).

    Even StanceRank: E
    Skill: TaiJutsu/Supplementary
    Effect: Natural Position, easy to reproduce.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: One of the four stances a user may learn as they are able to learn just one if they wish. Small base of support in the front-back plane. Body isn't sturdy, so it can move if in high winds. Lowers area for string clearance, especially for large chested shooters. Many Marksman prefer the even stance. In this stance, the Marksman’s body weight is evenly distributed among both feet, and the heels and toes are aligned. The middle of the instep of the foot is aligned with the center of the target.
    Limit: Must be a Marksman.
    Open StanceRank: E
    Skill: TaiJutsu/Supplementary
    Effect: Gives stable support base, reduces tendency to lean back from the target.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: One of the four stances a user may learn as they are able to learn just one if they wish. Tends to make upper body twist towards target. Tends to use arm muscles more than back muscles to draw. Open stance is recommended for the beginning Marksman during their initial learning period. In this stance, the feet should be shoulder-width apart. It is recommended that the Marksman should distribute his/her body weight evenly on both feet.

    Skill: TaiJutsu/Supplementary
    Effect: Gives stable support base, Gives good alignment of the arm and shoulder in direct line to the target.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: One of the four stances a user may learn as they are able to learn just one if they wish. Reduces string clearance, so string may strike against body. Tends to make Marksman lean away from target and overdraw the arrow. A closed stance. The shooting line is straddled and weight is evenly distributed among both feet. Left foot is moved forward a few inches so a heel-toe alignment exists between the left and right feet respectively.
    Limit: Must be a Marksman.
    Oblique StanceRank: E
    Skill: TaiJutsu/Supplementary
    Effect: Gives the greatest amount of clearance for the bowstring when arrows is released. Body is in total equilibrium. Target can be seen clearly.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: One of the four stances a user may learn as they are able to learn just one if they wish. Hard to maintain, so mainly used by expert Marksman. Some elite Marksman use the oblique stance. In this stance the Marksman places his/her toe of the left foot nearest the target on a line and pivoting the left foot forty-five-degrees to the target. The heel of the right foot is then placed in line with the toe of the left foot. This allows the bow arm to remain in a position where there will be optimum clearance of the bowstring when the arrow is released. The target should be seen clearly while using the oblique stance.
    Limit: Must be a Marksman.

When the user learns this technique the final time they are able to redirect 150% of the opponent's attacking power back to the opponent causing significant damage. When first learning the user must train 20 TP. Each additional learning the user must train an additional 10 TP on top of the TP needed to learn the technique previously. Example: Learning the technique a 3rd time takes 40 TP while learning the technique the 6th time takes 70 TP.

    Tai no HenkoRank: D
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: Altering the direction of an incoming attack.

This is the basis of Ura movements in footwork. Bring the toes of the left foot to meet the toes of the opponent's right foot. Turn in a circular movement into a position along the opponent's side. When pivoting, open the fingers fully and extend ki. Learn to keep the hips stable regardless of whether the opponent pushes or pulls. Pivot around and bring the fingers of both hands to the same level.

Pivot in place, shifting to Ai Hanmi; look in the same direction as the opponent. Raise the hands upward, pulling the opponent off balance and enter behind them with the left foot. Shift the weight to the left foot and extend the arms towards the opponent's head to execute the throw. Be sure that the eyes continue to look forward to avoid a possible kicking counter.

Beware: the body pushes through the arms, there is nothing like one arm pushes, one arm pulls. The arms do nothing, they just stay in front of you. At the end, don't lean on uke.     Ryotedori Nikyo Omote (1)Rank: C
    Skill: TaiJutsu
    Effect: A struggling counter used against an opponent who has grabbed the user by performing a pronating wristlock takedown.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Picture When your partner grabs both your hands from Right Hanmi, step powerfully to the left and release your right hand by moving your elbow inwards, breaking the grip. Grab his right hand with your right hand and his left elbow with your left hand. Begin twisting your hips powerfully to the right. Bring your partner's arm down in front of your abdomen while applying strong Nikyo pressure to his wrist. Having unbalanced your partner, take a large step diagonally forward with your left foot, placing your left hip against his side. Pin his shoulder to the mat as you change into the Nikyo pinning position. Apply the Nikyo pin with your entire body by inclining forward. When an opponent is on the ground, the user is free to break an elbow, dislocate the shoulder, dislocate the write, or even strike the controlled target. The user is able to redirect 15% of the opponent's fighting power back to the opponent when performing this technique as a counter.
    Limit: Must learn from an Aikido Master. Must know Basic Techniques.

At this point the target can make another save. Any made save against this effect renders the target immune to this effect from this item ever again. Building an emotional effect into a craftwork has a cost of 1/10 of total cost (Materials are not purchased), and once the extra component and the original item are both complete, the item is then ready for use. With this and other bonus craft abilities, the Artisan can add multiple layers of components to a single item, so it is possible to have an item built to Tame the Savage Breast, Impart a Hidden Meaning, and use the Fool’s Prerogative all at once, providing that the relevant providing the crafting cost is implemented during the course of crafting.
    Limit: Must be an Artisan.
    • Evoke Emotional Response
    Rank: C
    Skill: Supplementary
    Effect: The Artisan’s ability to create has reached the point that they can start to create items that give and emotional response to people that see or use them.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: This is an enhancement of the Tame the Savage Breast ability. The Artisan can choose a particular emotion to evoke with any of their work; whether it be confidence, fear, horror, love, doubt or any other kind of reaction. The target of the emotional response must also be chosen by the Artisan from the possible options of: “the owner”, “the wearer”, “the reader”, “the user” or “the audience”. Building an emotional effect into a craftwork has a cost of 1/10 of total cost (Materials are not purchased), and once the extra component and the original item are both complete, the item is then ready for use. The Save is the same as Tame the Savage Beast.
    • Desire: User feels a strong urge to be in the presence of the desired object or creature. The enchanted creature suffers a -20 on Sense Motive checks against the desired creature.
    • Despair: The enchanted creatures suffer a -2 penalty to Saves, -5 to Attack Damage, and -10 Skill Checks.
    • Fear: The enchanted creatures flee from the character whenever they are in sight of the character. Emotion (Fear) dispels emotion (rage).
    • Friendship: The enchanted creatures react more positively toward others. Their attitude shifts to the next more favorable reaction (hostile to unfriendly, unfriendly to indifferent, indifferent to friendly, or friendly to helpful). Creatures involved in combat, however, continue to fight back normally. Emotion (Friendship) dispels emotion (Hate).
    • Hate: The enchanted creatures react more negatively towards others. Their attitude shifts to the next less favorable reaction (helpful to friendly, friendly to indifferent, different to unfriendly, or unfriendly to hostile). Emotion (Hate) dispels emotion (Friendship).
    • Hope: The enchanted creatures gain a +2 morale bonus to Saves, +5 to Attack Damage, and +10 Skill Checks. Emotion (Hope) dispels Emotion Despair).
    • Rage: The Enchanted creatures gain a +2 morale bonus to Might and Toughness scores, a +1 morale bonus to Will Saves, and a -1 to all Minor Defenses. They are compelled to fight heedless of danger. Emotion (Rage) does not stack with Brawler Rage or with itself. Emotion (Rage) dispels Emotion (Fear).

    Target must make a Will save or be affected by the Emotion. This Save is 10 + 2 per Artisan's Class Level + Impeccable Will at time of creation. +3,000 Ryo to Crafting Time.
    Limit: Must be an Artisan. Must know Tame the Savage Beast.

If the save is failed, the target immediately takes the listed damage and is now diseased. (Diseased characters must make an additional save every day or take the listed damage again. If a successful save is made 2 days in a row, the disease is cured.) Once a character is diseased, the infectious weapon just deals normal damage. It is not possible to suffer the same disease more than once. An infectious weapon cannot also be defending, merciful, or holy. A ranged weapon with this ability confers it on ammunition fired.     Cure DiseaseRank: C
    Type: Restoration Ritual
    Effect: Even the most horrid affliction disappears in response to the user's healing touch.
    Special: To perform: 10 minutes; Duration: Instantaneous
    Drawback: ---
    Description: The Cure Disease ritual wipes away a single disease afflicting the subject, whether the disease is active or still incubating. The subject is completely cured and loses any negative side effects and symptoms of the disease. This ritual is physically taxing to the recipient; if used on an injured character, it can even kill them. Upon completing this ritual, make a First Aid: Healing skill check, using the Rank of the disease as a penalty to this check (+10 to Check from "C" Rank Rituals, +10 per additional Rank). The result indicates the amount of damage the target takes. Assuming the character survives, this damage can be healed normally.
    Failed by 50 or more: Death
    Failed by 49 to 40: Damage equal to Critical
    Failed by 39 to 30: Damage equal to Serious
    Failed by 29 to 20: Damage equal to Moderate
    Failed by 19 to 10: Damage equal to Light
    Failed by 9 to 1: Damage equal to Minor
    Success: No Damage

    If the user knows that their subject is suffering from multiple diseases, user must choose which one this ritual will cure. Otherwise, the ritual affects whichever single disease the user knows about. The user learns the Disease Rank when they begin the ritual, and at that point you can choose not to continue, without expending any components.
    Limit: Must be a Ritualist for Restoration Rituals.

Creation Ritual Lore Mastery determines how long the arms and the abilities can last in a day, and also specifics the number of abilities granted, which are chosen by the recipient among the list below.
    • Novice: Time: 3 hours - Number of Abilities: 1
    • Average: Time: 6 hours - Number of Abilities: 2
    • Advanced: Time: 9 hours - Number of Abilities: 3
    • Expert: Time: 12 hours - Number of Abilities: 4
    • Master: Time: 15 hours - Number of Abilities: 5

    The user reverts to their normal self at the end of the time period. Transforming into and out of Marilith takes a "B" Rank weaving movement.
    • Hacking Blades - When an adjacent enemy misses the user with a melee attack, the user gains an opportunity of attack against the enemy.
    • Resist 20 Variable - As a "C" Rank weaving movement the user chooses a type of damage from the following list: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Sonic. The user gains the specified amount of resistance to the chosen damage type for the rest of the encounter, or until they decide to alter the Resistance type. User may perform this up to 3 times per Encounter.
    • Shroud of Steel - As a "B" Rank weaving movement the user can use 2 of their weapons to attack while the others parry incoming attacks, gaining 20 Deflection (+5 per Weapon. This Deflection bonus may stack with another Deflection bonus) until the start of their next turn.
    • The Abyssal Lady - As a "B" rank weaving movement, The Abyssal Lady enables recipient to turn their legs into a serpentine tail which is treated as a natural weapon. The recipient gains darkvision 20 meters. If the user has Darkvision then increase Darkvision by +15 meters.. Moreover, The Abyssal Lady is considered as a Large creature and has a reach of Large for their attacks.
    • Weapon Dance - The ritual's components does not include the cost of 6 weapons. These weapons are imbued into the recipient of the Ritual when the ritual is performed. The weapons are not visible when the user is in their normal state. These weapons only appear once the user transforms into the Marilith, and disappear again when they revert to their normal self. Only way a user may alter their weapons of choice is by having the ritual performed on them again specifically for Weapon Alternating.


    Limit: Must be a Ritualist for Creation Rituals.
    Cost: Market Price: 48,000 Ryo Performing Price: 36,000 Ryo

In the majority of cases, once a mineral is harnessed it does not matter whether the Chakra is divine or Natural as anybody can use the harnessed mineral. Lazurite is one of the rare minerals that, once its Alchemy is harnessed, it can only be used by one particular group of people, Natural Chakra users.     Effect: A gem carved to freeze a large area including water.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Equipment Type: Slotless. Crystal Ice is harnessed from a diamond with a deep blue color and is the size of a human thumbnail. The natural Alchemy of the diamond can be harnessed by a skilled alchemist crafting the diamond into the shape of a 1-inch square cube. Once crafted, crystal ice allows the bearer to dramatically lower the temperature in an area extending out in a 100-meter radius from the gem 1 per day. Once activated, the temperature within the area of effect gradually lowers to well below freezing over a period of 10 minutes. This dramatic drop in temperature lasts for 12 hours. The extreme temperature conditions created by crystal ice cause unprotected characters to suffer 6 Armour Points of Cold damage for each minute of exposure. Any existing weather conditions that were in place when the gem is activated are stacked on top of the extreme cold created by the gem. For example, rain becomes freezing rain or snow; fog becomes freezing fog, etc. If crystal ice is placed in water and activated, the water will become frozen out to the area of effect of the gem. If placed in a large enough body of water (large lake, ocean) the gem will create a hemisphere of ice to a depth of 100 meters and a diameter of 200 meters. Crystal ice that is activated in the presence of a water elemental that is unable to flee before the full effects take place, will force the elemental to make a Fortitude save 15 or become frozen into a solid block of ice. The elemental is unharmed by this transformation and returns to its normal state once the duration of the activation expires. The gem may trap aquatic animals if activated in water. These animals become frozen within the ice created and are unharmed by the process, returning to normal once the duration of the activation expires. Crystal ice has no effect on creatures (other than elementals) with the water sub-type. Fire-based creatures suffer 12 Armour Points of Cold damage for each minute of exposure to the gems effects.
    Ingredients: 1 medium Diamond (35,000 Ryo).
    Limit: These types of items may be bought inside any Alchemy Shop. 5% chance finding.

    Type: Secondary, 3,000 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
    Effect: A gem capable of removing the effects of death so long as it is held by the user.

    Description: Equipment Type: Slotless. To prevent death is one of the most sought after protections. Jutsus can provide some protection from certain forms of death, and other objects and alchemy exist that can also protect against death in one form or another. Casius Trellium Fennel, an Alchemist follower of Jute, and harnesser of the first immortality stone also researched ways to prevent death from occurring as part of his research into immortality. Years before he harnessed the first immortality stone Casius harnessed the alchemy within a flawless zircon as a ward against death. The leaders of the Church hailed Casius and this gave him confidence to continue his search for immortality. When a nearly flawless zircon gem is cut into the shape of a tear about 1/2 an inch long and with a slight curl at the apex of the tear the natural Alchemy within the zircon is harnessed. A person who holds Death's tear is warded against all forms of death including death Jutsus, Alchemical death effects, energy drain, and negative energy effects. The person is also warded against these other death effects with the following restrictions: Armour Point loss (the person still falls unconscious but stabilizes and begins to heal normally at that point), poison (the person still suffers damage, but cannot die from the damage taken), ability loss (the person still loses the points, he just cannot die from a Toughness score of -15), and petrification (though it does not prevent the actual turning to stone, a person warded still becomes a statue, but they still live within the stone). The only flaw in the Alchemy is that it does not prevent death from old age. For this reason, Casius continued his search for the immortality stone.
