    Description: Equipment Type: Slotless. A mineral alchemist named Jorga Ironstone made the initial discovery that led to the whetstone bearing his name. Jorga found that diamond could be pulverized down to fine, sand-sized particles, yet still retain hardness. At first he was unsure of any uses for the diamond sand, other than coming in handy for polishing suits of armor and other metal objects. As with many alchemical discoveries, a chance accident led Jorga to find another use for the diamond sand. Jorga was working on a new alchemical resin when the pot he was stirring broke, spilling the resin. Jorga quickly grabbed the closest substance to stop the spill, a bag of diamond sand. The sand absorbed the resin and formed a rock hard lump of sand. The lump was about to be thrown out by Jorga's assistant, but Jorga kept it, in the nature of all alchemists, to be able to experiment with. What Jorga found was that the combined sand and resin mixture made a very effective whetstone. It could sharpen the dullest blade, and that blade would retain its edge far longer than normal. Jorga made several whetstones and gave them away to family and friends. After his death, his name was given to the amazing whetstone he had created. When a person uses a Jorga's Whetstone to sharpen a slashing or piercing weapon (dagger, swords, axes, arrows, etc.), the weapon receives a +2 Alchemical Bonus to Attack Damage. This bonus lasts for 1 week.

Many alchemists had tried other ways to cut the gem, but this alchemist, whose name has never been released, realized that the secret might be hidden further in the already discovered geometry.     Type: Secondary, 15 per Slot, Harnessed Gem
    Effect: A gem specialized to send messages to multiple gems attuned to it.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Equipment Type: Slotless. The renowned alchemist, scholar, and inventor, Alyx Anderbell, harnessed the first sending gem and demonstrated the useful qualities of the gem by sending a short message to his assistant. A sending gem is harnessed out of several flawless quartz crystals, a minimum of two, which have grown together into a single mass. To fully harness the crystal's alchemical properties, the mass of crystals must be carefully separated into individual crystals without damaging any of the crystals. Once separated and the alchemy is harnessed, the individual crystals become attuned to each other. From then on, the bearer of one crystal can send and receive messages to any or all of the other crystals that have been attuned. Each crystal is marked with a alchemical mark to label it, typically with a unique number or name. The bearer can then specify "all" to send a message to all crystals that have been attuned, or can specify a known crystal by its unique identifier to send a message to only one attuned crystal. By using this latter method, it is possible to send a message to a sending gem that has not been attuned with the bearer's gem, as long as the unique identifier is known. To use a sending gem, the bearer holds the gem before their head about 6 inches away and speaks in a clear voice. On the receiver's gem, a small auditory tone or bell sounds, announcing the receipt of a message. The message is delivered in real time and is auditory as well as visual, showing an image of the speaker's head. This allows messages to be heard if visual conditions do not allow the receiver to see the sending gem, and allows a recipient to see the other speaker and possibly understand the message if the recipient cannot hear. The speaker can hold the gem closer and whisper if they want. Sending gems have spread across the globe and have found their way into many adventuring bands due to their usefulness. In addition, in wealthy, alchemically rich regions, many people can afford to buy sending gems for personal use, where they can either be attached at a fixed location, or carried by individuals.

    Description: Freshwater pearls are relegated to a second-class status as gems. Not as lustrous or brilliant as a true marine pearl, they are accepted but not as sought after as gemstones. The gems natural Alchemical properties was not realized until recently. A naturalist follower of Brixbrix named James Doolittle traveled to a small island in the Sea Country Islands to study the unique animal life there. There, he harvested a freshwater oyster for one of his meals and found a pearl inside. While pleased with his find, Doolittle thought little of it, and over the next few weeks he kept the pearl with him, and actually began to carve the pearl while watching the birds and large iguanas on the island. At first the carving had no shape, but after a couple of days the pearl took on the shape of a mouth. After finishing the carving, Doolittle realized he could now talk to the animals. He was amazed by the new ability, and soon figured out it was due to the pearl he had carved. Doolittle finished the research he was doing, and went on to great fame as a champion of animal rights. He never let on how he had the ability to speak with animals, and it wasn’t until after his death that his secret was revealed. Since then, Alchemists have been harnessing the natural Alchemical properties of the freshwater pearl. When a freshwater pearl carved into the shape of a mouth is held or worn the bearer is able to speak with animals. This ability functions continuously while the pearl is held. The pearl is often set into a headband or a necklace.

Today, gems of energy can be found across the globe. To harness the Alchemy from the topaz, a gem of the correct color must be carved into the correct shape. Depending on the beginning value of the topaz, the gem of energy will provide slight, moderate, or greater protection from one of the 5 different energy sources; fire, electricity, cold, acid, or sonic (whether from a natural or Chakra source). The table below details the colors of the topaz, their carved shape, value, and what protection they provide. The gems grant energy resistance to the wearer so that each time the creature takes damage from the appropriate source, that damage is then reduced by the appropriate amount.
    • Red; Fire; Flame Carving — Slight 10 — Moderate 20 — Greater 30
    • Clear; Electricity; Lightning Bolt Carving — Slight 10 — Moderate 20 — Greater 30
    • Blue/White; Cold; Snowflake Carving — Slight 10 — Moderate 20 — Greater 30
    • Green; Acid; Teardrop Carving — Slight 10 — Moderate 20 — Greater 30
    • Orange; Sonic; Flute Carving — Slight 10 — Moderate 20 — Greater 30

    The protective power from gems of energy does not stack, so wearing multiple gems of one color does not increase the amount of damage that is reduced. Different types of gems of energy can be worn to provide protection from multiple energy sources.

    Mineral Recipes»


    SaltpeterRank: A
    Type: Very Rare, —, Alchemical Mineral
    Effect: Used to create fertilizers, propellants, fireworks, and preservatives.
    Special: Preparation: —; Duration: —
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Dissolve the bat droppings in the water. Pour it into the cup with the water and stir gently every few minutes until it looks completely dissolved. Use a cloth and filter the solution into a small container. This will take care of any undissolved bat droppings that might remain. Heat it slowly, over low heat, stirring occasionally until everything is dissolved. Do not let the solution come to a boil. Filter the solution into a freezer-safe container. Use cloth to get rid of any remaining solutions. Chill solution. As it chills, white crystals will begin to form. When it seems as though no more whitecrystals will form, the process is complete. Pour out the liquid. Grind the crystals into powder. This will produce 1 flat-canister of "Saltpeter".
    Ingredients: 1 flat-canister of bat droppings. 1 standard-bottle of water.
    Region: Special; Identification: Difficult; Cultivation: Average
    Limit: Must know Geology. 3% chance in finding.
    Cost: 480 Ryo per Flat-Canister.

This allows the hair to push from the scalp and outwards, creating a massive growth of the user's hair. The hair itself will continue to grow for as long as the user maintains the Ram handseal. It takes one turn to grow about five feet of hair.

    Effect: Allows the hair to fold in on itself several times so that it looks like the original layer of hair before the Hair Extension technique.
    Special: "Hand Seals"- Monkey, Horse, Rabbit, Dog, Tiger, Ram, Bird
    Drawback: Requires a (very) small but constant amount of chakra to keep the hair folded in the way that it is. This means that if the user runs out of chakra then the hair will let itself all loose.

Then, the user controls the hair using their chakra and pulls it in on itself, over and over, and tightens itself so that all the hair grown from the Hair Extension technique is seemingly invisible. The user must perform the Kai technique to cancel the hair folds.

    Name: Catwalk StunnerRank: C, B, A, S
    Skill:Ninjutsu
    Effect: Allows user to weave hair together to create clothing for themselves, for fashion and protection.
    Special:---
    Drawback: Can only create full, or partial Cat Suits out of hair. Can be as elaborate as user desires. Color is limited to the color of the users hair. Like all armor, is vulnerable to sundering. Can not be used in conjunction with purchasable armor.
    Description: Picture, Picture: With their control over their hair, they can extend their hair out and create for themselves a cat suit made of said hair. The suit will appear as if it were made of leather like material. However, this Catsuit is composed of vast amounts of hair woven together, through chakra to act as Armor, and a conduit for spells. The Level of the jutsu determines the strength of the hair's Armor Function and the level of Wicked Weave techniques that can be performed.

    Armor Equilevant
    C-Rank: 2 hardness; 10 armor Points. All C-rank Wicked Weave Jutsu can be used.
    B-rank: 4 hardness; 20 Armor Points. All B-Rank Wicked Weave Jutsu can be used.
    A-rank: 8 hardness; 30 Armor Points. All A-Rank Wicked Weave Jutsu can be used.
    S-rank: 16 hardness; 40 Armor Points. All S-Rank Wicked Weave Jutsu can be used.

    The Cat walk stunner is also treated as Armor in regards to Sundering as well. If the catwalk Stunner is sundered, the hair is cut to shoulder length. While regrowing the hair is possible and expedited by jutsu, it will take a minimum of 5 rounds to grow enough hair to use a C ranked Catwalk stunner, and an additional 5 rounds for each rank of Catwalk Stunner. (Basically meaning it would take 25 rounds, or 2.5 minutes to grow enough hair to use and S rank Catwalk stunner, after sundering.) The Technique lasts for 5 hours per Class level.
    Limit: Must Know Ninpou: Kami Shihai (Ninja Art: Hair Extension). Can not be stacked/used with wearable Armor, or Chakra Armor. Universal Ninjutsu. Must be at least B Class.

The same chakra enriched hair that made it possible for hair color to change, and form more malleable formation, increase the strength of the weaving. This increases the Armor properties of the Catwalk stunner by 25%, bringing it to 20 hardness; 50 Armor points. However, this is special chakra enriched hair, so once sundered it can not simply be regrown.     Curse Seal »


    Tenfuin (Heaven Seal)Rank: C (Stage 0), "B" (Stage 1), "S" (Stage 2)
    Type: Beneficial
    History: Even the history behind the Tenfuin is one that is dark and unknown to many. It starts with one man and his desire to create powerful minions that he could control and manipulate as he pleased; that man was named Legion, and he would be the one to create the Tenfuin. This Legion would experiment on the people that inhabited his village, Sand, to fine tune what would become the Tenfuin. Legion would have to make some adjustments, though, if he wanted to continue his work. The village seemed to disagree with Legion’s ways and how he got things done.

    So, Legion would decide to leave Sand and continue to do things for his own interest, but among those interests, the Tenfuin was there. Legion had an urge to do things on his own. He would travel away and continue his studies else where, away from Sand and their opinions of his work. Legion soon took notice of his test subjects dying from receiving the seal- and dying frequently, though, the benefits of the Tenfuin were soon to his liking. Legion soon met a certain Uchiha Abaddon and Kamyuja Kuro, and taught them all about the Tenfuin.
    Appearance:

    • Stage Zero: Appearance . Three black teardrops at the location of the seal.
    • Stage One: Appearance. A complicated pattern of darkness surrounds the three tear-drops. These patterns will then spread rapidly over the user's body as the seal remains active, somewhat like This.
    • Stage Two: Stage two is difficult to describe. The spreadings of Stage One have progressed into immense proportions, covering the entire body. At that point, the user's own appearance will begin to shift. Their body will begin to take the shape of their own inner soul.
    • Note: When a Shinobi receives the Heaven Seal, then they are required to write out a detailed description of what their Stage Two form looks like. This is mandatory and will be a part of the Seal Gaining Process.

    Effect: Increases the user's speed, endurance, physical strength, and chakra levels.

    • Stage Zero (Passive): This Stage, also known as the Passive Stage, is where the Seal is simply laying dormant on the body. At this stage, the Seal is considered "C" Rank. The benefits of Seal at this stage are little, but they do exist. Increases the user's chakra level by a small amount, also bestows a small amount of endurance.
    • Stage One: Moving from Stage Zero to Stage One the first time is a very painful process. However, once Stage One has been accomplished, transitioning between the Stages causes little to no pain. At this point, the user's physical strength and endurance are dramatically increased, as well as bestowing a large amount of chakra to the user. Finally, the user's speed is increased a small amount. The user's Strength and Endurance increases as their speed increases by .10 (10%) times movements of the user.
    • Stage Two: Moving from Stage One to Stage Two for the first time is an even more difficult process than from Stage Zero to Stage One. In order for this to occur, the user must "Die". The person who placed the Seal upon the User is the only person capable of calling for the Seal to begin its progression from Stage One to Stage Two, which means that the user must again hunt down those that placed the seal upon them and ask him to transform them. Once the passing is complete, the user is capable of moving from Stage One to Stage Two at will. Stage Two grants a gargantuan amount of physical strength and endurance. Speed is increased by a factor of up to .66 (66%) times the user's movements, and the user's chakra levels increases ten times as normal.

    Description: A powerful Seal that has a very low success rate of survival. The seal comes in three stages, Passive, Stage One, and Stage Two. As the Seal progresses, the user is forced to accept a large amount of pain and both their physical and mental endurances are pushed beyond their limits. Because of this, those that survive the Seal's progression are commonly far more capable of fighting than others.
    Placement Requirements:

    • Admin Approval
    • An Event involving hearing about, hunting down, and finally getting the NPC to give the Seal to you, must also try to convince the NPC to give the seal out. Reasons why is sometimes depending on how a character is they might not give the seal out.
    • A roll must be done by the Admin or a Head Mod, in which they must land a 10 or lower. (The Admin has the power to bypass the roll if he believes that the seeker shows a high enough level of RP during the pain process of the seal).

    Tenfuin: Stage ZeroRank: C Rank
    Skill: FuinJutsu
    Effect: The passive form of the Tenfuin.
    Special: Having the Tenfuin being placed upon the user.
    Drawback: N/A
    Description: While in the Passive Stage is in effect, there are no drawbacks to the user. However, the user gains a small amount of chakra to their overall levels, as well as giving the tiniest boost of endurance.
    Limit: Must be placed on the user by somebody who knows how to place the Seal.
    Tenfuin: Stage OneRank: B Rank
    Skill: FuinJutsu
    Effect: Increases physical speed, power, and endurance. Increases the user's chakra level.
    Special: Channeling a small amount of chakra into the seal.
    Drawback: Drains chakra at a rate of 3% per turn, meaning that this ability, on top of using chakra to fight, can quickly tire the user out.
    Description: Stage One increases the user's physical strength, speed, and endurance by a large amount. They become much more capable of fighting hand to hand, as their body responds more quickly than most forms of training can produce. Their strikes become strengthened twofold, their muscles suddenly capable of performing at higher rates than normal. Beyond that, they are capable of fighting for much more extended periods, as their body seems to thrive off of the battle. Even beyond all of the physical attributes gained by the Seal, the user's chakra level will increase a substantial amount, allowing them the ability to perform jutsu as if they were one Difficulty Class above their current level (please note, this does not mean that they can use this ability to learn jutsu faster or to learn jutsu that their rank does not allow them to learn, but rather allows them the ability to perform more jutsu for less of a cost). When the Tenfuin Stage One is gained, it takes three IC turns to spread the seal all the way across the body. After the First round they will reach times .03 (3%) times their movements. After the Second Round they will reach times .06 (6%) times thier movements. After the Third Round theu reach the full .10 (10%) times their movements.
    Limit: Gaining Stage One is a long process in which is forced upon the user immediately after receiving Stage Zero. This process is highly dangerous, and during this process, many hundreds of potential recipients and experiments have perished. Pain beyond imagine is forced through the user's body, stretching out their physical and mental limits. The power of the Seal somehow prohibits people from going unconscious as this pain soars through their body, thus they either remain awake or they perish. As Stage Zero of the Seal is placed upon the user, the seal rapidly drains the user of their chakra, pushing them into levels of below 5% of all of their chakra. This chakra is pumped throughout the body, forcing it to be ready to perform the remarkable feats that the seal allows the body to do. This process lasts for Twenty Full Length RP posts, in which the user must describe the chakra changing each part of their body to become more proficient. These “Pain” posts are graded by the admin like training posts, requiring the user to gain the proper amount of “TP” (apply Difficulty Class) with one exception- the maximum number of points capable of being allotted at once are 5.
    Tenfuin: Stage TwoRank: A Rank
    Skill: FuinJutsu
    Effect: Substantially increases the user's fighting capability.
    Special: Forcing the Stage One Tenfuin to spread all the way across the body.
    Drawback: Drains chakra from the user at a rate of 5% per turn. If used for more than fifteen IC turns, then the user's fighting capability becomes reduced by 50%.
    Description: Loki's Stage Two:As the Stage Two becomes prominent, the spreadings of the Stage One seal have moved all the way across the body, giving it a dark hue. These spreadings have also caused the body to transform, giving it a completely different shape. Although remaining humanoid in appearance, those who survive to reach Stage Two often take on either an animalistic or demonic-seeming appearance. Once in Stage Two, the user's fighting capabilities are increased by a substantial amount, allowing them to lift objects heavier than they would have previously thought possible (physical strength x3). Their speed and endurance both increase by a large amount as well, allowing them to move at speeds of .66 (66%) times their movements. Finally, their chakra using capabilities increase to a level such as they appear to be one point five times Difficulty Class levels higher. Beyond all of this, the user often picks up abilities that they may gain from their own different transformations (ex: Levitation with grown wings). When the Tenfuin Stage Two is gained, it takes three IC turns to transform the whole body. After the First round they will reach times .22 (22%) times their movements. After the Second Round they will reach times .44 (44%) times thier movements. After the Third Round theu reach the full .66 (66%) times their movements. This does not stack up to your first stage.
    Limit: Part of the Requirement of gaining the Second Stage of the Tenfuin is writing out your appearance at Stage Two and submitting it for customs. Included in this description are any special abilities that your Transformed Stage Two form may be able to perform. These abilities will, of course, be required to be learned additionally. In order to gain Stage Two, the user must hunt down the person who gave them the Tenfuin to begin with and ask them to progress it to Stage Two. If the Giver of the seal agrees, then they will give the user a drug known as Seishingan. This process is similar to that of the Stage Zero to Stage One transformation, causing the body to activate the Stage One seal and then drain all of that chakra, transforming the user’s body to the point that they are capable of handling the Tenfuin Stage Two. This process lasts like the transition between Stage 0 and Stage One, requiring the user to gain “TP” that is graded by the admin, with a maximum number of five points per post by the user, in which the user will describe the changes being made to their body. If the drug is administered within the confines of an object marked with the Shikokumujin seal, then there is a 0% chance to die. If they are not, then they must make the same roll that they made from Stage Zero to Stage One.
    Tenfuin: Rapid ProgressionRank: “B” Rank
    Skill: Training
    Effect: Allows the user to rapidly transition between Stage Zero and Stage Two.
    Special: Dedicated training in using the seal, forcing it to spread faster.
    Drawback: Uses the same amount of chakra no matter how fast the seal progresses, so the user may feel as if they run out of chakra faster from progressing the seal faster.
    Description: This training method allows the user the ability to rapidly force their seal to progress their seal from Stage Zero to Stage Two. Instead of taking three turns, those with this training will find themselves capable of progressing their Seal from Stage Zero to Stage Two within one turn.
    Limit: Must have the Tenfuin Stage Two
    Tenfuin: Partial TransformationRank: “A” Rank
    Skill: FuinJutsu
    Effect: Allows the user the ability to only partially transform body parts under the effect of the Seal.
    Special: Special training that allows the user to only partially transform.
    Drawback: If only certain parts of the body are transformed, then the full effects of the Stage Two Tenfuin cannot be realized (Divide the effectiveness of the Seal’s bonus depending on the number of limbs transformed, the more the better – ex: Head, Chest, L. Arm, R. Arm, L. Leg, R. Leg; If only the L. Arm is transformed, then only 1/6 of the seals benefits are given, and only given to that arm).
    Description: This ability can be used to surprise the opponent, especially in hand to hand combat. The user will partially transform their body, allowing only a portion of their body to gain the benefits of the seal, like increased strength. The upside to this is that partially transforming consumes less chakra (1% max / turn), as well as allowing the user to strategically use their transformations for balance, aerodynamics, etc.
    Limit: Must have Tenfuin: Rapid Progression

    Description: By sacrificing a movement, the user can sense the presence or absence of creatures (or anything else) within a Soul within a cone distance of 20 meters + 2 meters per Resonance Technique. And their relative numbers and directions from the user, but not a pinpoint location. Most solid materials do not block this sense, but at least 2 meters of stone, wood, or earth, or 3 inches of iron or other heavy metal will block it, as will any solid sheet of lead. If the user has at least 25 Skill Points in Soul Wavelength then whenever they use Soul Tuning, the user can gain a general location as if they were using Blindsense, but only for the purpose of detecting things with souls. Also as an additional movement, the user may pinpoint the exact location of the soul as if they had Blindsight. In half a round action the user can gauge the Soul's Power. "D" Class Faint, "C" Class Moderate, "B" Class Strong, "A" and "S" Class Overwhelming. If the user's Class Level is "C" or lower, then they gauge an overwhelming Aura, the user is Dazed for 1 round. If the user has 50 Points into Soul Wavelength, whenever the user detects Souls, they can detect the positions of Souls as if they had blindsight. Also, as a Movement the user may detect the Alignment of the soul they can sense. If the user has at least 75 points into Soul Wavelength, then during the first movement, the user can also sense the alignment, and within half a round, the user can learn the soul's type and subtype, and also the basic makeup of their Class Level Specialists. This allows the user to make performances with Soul Wavelength at a range greater than touch but within the distance of Soul Tuning.

The maximum Resonance Score the user may acquire is equal to 5 per Class Level. IF the user does not use Soul Resonance during a turn, the bonus resets to zero.
    Limit: Must be a Mabuki. Must know Soul Allegro.
    Soul DuetRank: B
    Skill: Supplementary
    Effect: The user becomes exceptionally good at resonating with another being.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Select 1 creature, whom the user knows, and can touch when learning this technique. When using any kind of Soul Wavelength check, the user may drop the Difficulty by 1 level even under heavy stress. Any creature the users chooses that has the capability to change into a Weapon (including but not limited to a Mabuki member) may consider the user to be the Meister at any time, even if the user is not currently wielding them. The user may learn this technique multiple times. Each time learned, the user may choose a different creature. Additionally, when taking this technique, the user may delay the choosing of a creature. While doing so the user gains no benefit from this technique. When the user wishes to choose a creature for this technique, all it takes is a Movement touch, and if the chosen creature is unwilling, the user must make a Soul Wavelength check equal to Very Difficult + 5 Target's Impeccable Will. Getting hit by an attack while attempting to choose will foil the attempt. A miss or foiled attempt does not "use up" this ability. The user can continue attempting to choose until a creature is chosen.
    Limit: Must be a Mabuki. Must know Soul Resonance. Must know Soul Wavelength 35 Skill Points.
    Resonance TuningRank: B
    Skill: Supplementary
    Effect: The user is able to use a Soul Resonance directed at the user in a different way, increasing their ability to see Souls.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Whenever the user receives a bonus from Soul Resonance, instead of using it as a Damage Bonus, the user can instead use it to power up their Soul Tuning technique. After receiving the bonus, the user may add the Resonance Score of the character the user received the bonus from to their Resonance Score to determine the distance of the user's Soul Tuning ability. Additionally, the cone effect is 6 meters times the total Resonance Score, rather than 2 meters times the Resonance Score.
    Limit: Must be a Mabuki. Must know Soul Resonance. Must know Soul Wavelength 25 Skill Points.

    Monster Trainer »


    Capture MonsterRank: C
    Type: Binding Ritual
    Effect:
    Special: To perform: 10 minutes; Duration: Until Triggered
    Drawback: ---
    Description: This Ritual prepares the user to perform the Capture Monster Seal. After performing the Seal the target is captured and drawn into the Trainer's Aura. Its body is removed from combat until the Trainer calls upon it again. Monsters with Class Points above the user's Class Points, an already captured Monster, and any Epic Creature cannot be captured in this way. User may only perform this on Animal, and Mystical Beast Creature Types. To capture other creatures the user must learn additional techniques. The user gains the act of Calling, Controlling, and Recalling Monsters in or out of combat.
    • Calling Monsters: As a weaving movement, a Monster Trainer can call upon one of their monsters. This is identical to drawing a weapon. Calling upon even one monster is a rigorous mental activity. When faced with an immediate threat or distraction, all but one monster of the trainer's choice are returned to their essence as a free-movement. When called, the now Active Monster appears in an unoccupied area within 3 meters of the Trainer. If no such area exists, where the Monster can fit, the ability fails and the movement is lost.
    • Controlling Monsters: User follows same rules as Animal Training Skill, however user may control all Creatures instead of just Animals. The user may communicate with them Telepathically out to 30 meters.
    • Recalling Monsters: The trainer can use their telepathic bond to call their active Monster back into their essence as a weaving movement. When a monster is recalled, it fades away from reality, disappearing entirely. All negative effects on the Monster is halted until the creature becomes Active again. If a monster is reduced to 0 or fewer Armour Points, it is immediately recalled from any distance at 0 Armour Points as a free-movement. If a trainer dies, their monster fades back into their essence as a free-movement.
    • Downtime Activities: During downtime, a trainer can call upon some or all of their monsters to spend time with them; training animals, playing, interacting with or showing their monsters off to others.

    Limit: Must be a Ritualist for Binding Rituals. Must be a Monster Trainer.
    Cost: Market Price: 23,000 Ryo Performing Price: 17,000 Ryo
    • Capture Monster Seal
    Rank: B
    Skill: Fūinjutsu
    Effect: Capture monsters for use in training.
    Special: ----
    Drawback: ---
    Description: Duration of this seal is Permanent unless the user dismisses the Creature permanently, or the user dies. Performing the seal is a Weaving movement. Range of this technique is 7 meters + 6 meters per Class Level. Target is 1 Monster. Duration of this Technique is Instantaneous. Performing this Seal uses up the Ritual; meaning user must perform the ritual again in order to perform the Seal. A Will Save negates. The target gets a +5 bonus to its save while at or above half of its Armour Points. It gets a +2 bonus while at or above 1/4th of its total Armour Points. This bonus is reduced by 1 per Binding Ritual Lore Mastery. The seal will appear on the Monster and disappear leaving no residual Seal. User may perform this on a Scroll, Parchment or Jutsu Tag. The seal appears and stays on the Scroll, Parchment, or Jutsu Tag for the duration of the Seal or until a Jutsu has been performed on the Scroll, Parchment, or Jutsu Tag. User does not need Use Chakra Device due to the simplicity of the Seal. The user just uses a Weaving Movement with Handseals while holding onto the Scroll, Parchment, or Jutsu Tag (This does not take up Chakra). The Seal is then released and performs the actions.
    Limit: Must know Capture Monster.
    Monstrous CohortRank: B
    Skill: Supplementary
    Effect: User has picked up an unusual cohort.
    Special: ---
    Drawback: ---
    Description: User can now alter one of their Monsters gain the Cohort template. The Cohort takes up 1 of your 5 Cohort slots in Leadership. That monster can travel by your side instead of within your essence. Calling upon your Monster Cohort does not count against the user's limit of Monsters Active the user can control.
    Limit: Must be a Monster Trainer. Must know Leadership.


    Black Sun Seal »


    Eikoudan (Flare of the Black Sun)Rank: DCBA S
    Skill: Fuuinjutsu / Ninjutsu
    Effect: Allows the user to absorb an enemy opponent’s chakra through direct contact from both hands until they are fully drained of chakra and die. The amount of chakra attained at a time is equivalent to the rank the user knows for this jutsu. The higher ranked the amount of chakra absorbed, the more movements it will take to complete the transfer.
    Special: –
    Drawback: Chakra can only be attained from PC shinobi, and due to the excessive amount of movements required to absorb the chakra, is not recommended to be used in the heat of battle. It is the user’s responsibility to chronicle responsibly the exact amounts of chakra stored, and prepared to provide evidence via links to posts should one be questioned.
    Description: Once the user attains the seal, they are taught exactly how to harness their newfound talents in useful ways. The seal is capable of compressing large amounts of chakra into itself, and through the user’s hands, they apply an accelerated chakra draining effect, allowing them to store further chakra into their reservoirs. As they absorb chakra, the user’s tattoo grows longer, the ‘tail’ of the swirl slowly extending the circular pattern even further.
    Limit: Must have Onimusha no Taiyoushin.
    Bakoushou (Bursting of the Black Sun)Rank: S
    Skill: Fuuinjutsu
    Effect: Despite its rank, activating the seal costs only a ‘C’ ranked amount of chakra, as the bond between the seal and the chakra network allows the energy flow to commence at any time. The jutsu’s rank is merely representative of its prestige and difficulty in learning. The amount of chakra used is equivalent to whatever is stored in correlation to the rank of the jutsu being used.
    Special: –
    Drawback: If the user happens to go over the limit of chakra they have stored, they die on the spot. Once the user deactivates the seal, they cannot use Soldier Pills for the rest of the thread in order to try and get more chakra. Additionally, they are unable to use chakra for the same amount of turns spent with the seal active. If the user possesses some form of TaiJutsu enhancement such as the Gates or Rage, they cannot be active at the same time as the Onimusha no Taiyoushin.
    Description: Perhaps the most invigorating feeling ever, a wave crashes over you and refreshes you completely, surreal alertness keeping your eyes wide open as you are suddenly gifted with a potent dose of energy; such is a description said to be muttered from the mouths of those lucky enough to tote the Onimusha Seal. Given the user has a previously stored amount of chakra, the user lets the compressed chakra becoming active, available to be used on call. Each time chakra is used, an appropriately sized portion of the glowing swirl appears to ‘burn off’ and disappear.
    Limit: Must have Onimusha no Taiyoushin.



    Ritual of The Contract Bonds »


    IshindenshinRank: CC C
    Skill: Ninjutsu
    Effect: Allows both bonds to speak to each other in their minds
    Special: Holds Tiger Seal
    Drawback: --
    Description: Using the bond between both ends created by the ritual the receiver and the giver will be able to speak to each other in their heads and be able to talk to one another without using voices. Using the connection between both souls one end can just think out loud and the other end will be able to hear it. The users will not be able to search through the other ends mind however. They can chose whether or not they wish to speak in that frequency or go back to the normal frequency. It cannot be forced into the other persons head either. When first learned it will be able to used within the same thread. The second time it will be in the same board. Third time it can be used anywhere.
    Limit: Must have the Ritual of the Contract Bonds performed.
    Nozomi TemaeRank: C
    Skill: Ninjutsu/Supplementary
    Effect: Will send a signal towards the other end.
    Special: --
    Drawback: Cannot use to locate
    Description: Between the connection of the two ends one end will be able to signal the other person whether it is because he or she is in danger or he or she just wants company. One end of the bond will react causing a feeling of either distress of alarm to the other end. This will reach through anywhere in the world. This will not however be a means to locate the other end. It is just a means of notification of some sort.
    Limit: Must have the Ritual of the Contract Bonds performed.

    • Intelligence: Describes how well your character learns and reasons as well as retain complete knowledge, while using the knowledge to strike with their chakra.
    • Handseals – The measure of how quickly a user can perform Chakra Jutsus in a round. The more handseals the user has the more Chakra Jutsus they can perform, however each Jutsu still takes up 1 movement. For every 2 points applied to Intelligence, +5 for Handseals.
    • Chakra Damage – Chakra Damage is the inner ki damage you are able to apply against opponents and objects. Chakra Damage is applied to Chakra Jutsus such as NinJutsu. For every 2 points applied to Intelligence, +2 for Chakra Damage.
    • Skill Category 3 – Skills specific for academic knowledge as well as retaining that knowledge. For every 2 points applied to Intelligence, +5 for Skill Category 3.


    • Might: Measure’s the user’s physical power. It is important for characters that fight melee combat.
    • Attack Damage – Also known as TaiJutsu Damage. The physical damage you are able to apply to objects and opponents when performing TaiJutsu attacks. For every 2 points applied to Might, +5 for Attack Damage.
    • Might Skills – Skills specific for Strength capability. For every 2 points applied to Might, +5 for Might Skills.

    • Perception: Measures your perception, self-discipline, and empathy. This category dictates how you notice details, and apply your own mental will.
    • Will Saves – These saves reflect your resistance to mental influence as well as many Chakra effects as well as other mental effects. For every 2 points applied to Perception, +1 for Will.
    • Perception Skills – Skills specific for perception, and self-discipline. For every 2 points applied to Perception, +5 for Perception Skills.

    • Agility: Measure’s hand-eye coordination, agility, reflexes, and balance.
    • Movements – The measure of one’s ability to act, and react in a single round. Everything counts as a movement, performing Jutsus, drawing your weapon, making physical attacks; the more your character has the better they can act and react to a situation. For every 2 points applied to Agility, +1 for Movements.
    • Agility Skills – Skills specific for nimbleness and hand-eye coordination. For every 2 points applied to Agility, +5 for Agility Skills.

    • Charisma: Measures your force of personality, persuasiveness, and leadership.
    • Will Focus – Charisma increases a user's ability to perform Jutsus needing a Will Save. For Every 2 points applied to Charisma, +1 to Difficulty of Will Save Jutsus.
    • Charisma Skills – Skills specific for personality and persuasiveness. For every 2 points applied to Charisma, +5 for Charisma Skills.

    • Toughness: Represents the character’s health, stamina, and vital force.
    • Armour Points – Armour Points is calculated as one of two things, your character’s "Anime Defense", the ability to withstand outrageous attacks and continue to fight, and the resource used to withstand attacks before death. For every 2 points applied to Toughness, +5 for Armour Points.
    • Fortitude Saves – Saves that details how well you are able to withstand attacks on your body. These saves measure your ability to stand up to physical punishment or attack against your health. For every 2 points applied to Toughness, +1 for Fortitude.
    • Spring Time of Youth Points – A measure found in Chakra Gates that determine how well you are able to perform the Techniques found in Chakra Gates. For every 2 points applied to Toughness, +10 for Spring Time of Youth Points.

    • Luck: Represents a character's instincts, and natural talent.
    • Skill Improvement — Luck has no specific skills associated with it. For every 2 points applied to Luck, +5 to All Skills.
    • Dodge — Your training and reflexes is almost instinctual and can avoid an opponents' attacks. For every 2 points applied to Luck, +1 to Dodge Modifier.
    • Percentile Rolls — When looking for items in shops, plants or creatures in the wild you will need a staff member to roll a 1d100 for you. With Luck your rolls get better. For every 2 Points applied to Luck, +2% to Search Rolls. You also gain the same bonus to other any other 1d100 roll so long as it is not a Skill.
